work_item: Goal-related bounded candidate selection for ordinary Japanese DraftRelationProfile Core route

scope.route: Engine::execute Intent::DraftRelationProfile for ordinary Japanese saved-relation profile request
scope.selection: One revision-matched Store relation-index transaction selects active Facts for the exact subject across scopes, exact-subject Rules, and variable-subject Rules. The candidates seed the existing finite relation-shape builder; each shape uses active_relation_projection and the existing Core relation proof evaluator.
scope.ownership: Store supplies revision-checked derived candidates. Core retains shape interpretation, conditions, proof status, conflict/budget stops, profile units, model-approved surfaces, HYPOTHESIS guarantee and adoption. No parser grammar, separate decision authority, or external API was added.
scope.budget: Candidate selection, shape planning, projection and proof evaluation consume the sealed max_actions. Evidence output remains bounded by max_evidence_bytes.
scope.memory_revision: The revision observed by the index transaction is retained on successful ResultRecord and on an indexed budget stop.
scope.index_fallback: A missing/stale index is rebuilt once from the authenticated loaded current snapshot and retried. If a concurrent head advance prevents an indexed retry, the request uses its already-loaded immutable snapshot and the full-snapshot reference implementation.
scope.recovery: Profile Recovery continues exact retained-snapshot replay and current-memory recheck; this batch does not bound Recovery selection.
scope.schema: The new subject index is derived and rebuildable; persisted memory records and store schema identity are unchanged.
